quests.instruction: FLICK THE COIN TO VERIFY THE FACT
quests.passage: [Abyss Vent 11-1] Water near hydrothermal vents can reach temperatures of 350 degrees Celsius, which is high enough to melt lead. However, the extreme hydrostatic pressure at the bottom of the ocean prevents the water from boiling.

quests.hint: Check the last sentence discussing boiling and pressure conditions. (Diving calibration index 11-1)

quests.passage: [Coral Zone 11-2] Although coral reefs cover less than 0.1% of the world's ocean surface, they host and nurture over 25% of all marine life, earning them the nickname 'rainforests of the sea'.
